vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: clawddocs
Version: 1.2.2

The skill bundle is benign. All shell scripts (`scripts/*.sh`) are placeholders that only print messages to the console and do not perform any actual system commands, network requests, or file operations. The `SKILL.md` instructions guide the AI agent to act as a documentation expert, using these placeholder scripts and referencing a legitimate documentation domain (docs.clawd.bot). Configuration snippets in `snippets/common-configs.md` include environment variable placeholders (e.g., `${DISCORD_TOKEN}`), which is a standard practice for user-provided configuration and not an attempt at data exfiltration by the skill itself.

llm.summary: This skill is a documentation helper with simple local helper scripts, and the only notable issue is a gateway example that could expose a service if copied without care.

dimensions.detail: The helper scripts are small shell stubs that only echo information in this artifact; the config snippets include tokens as environment-variable placeholders and a gateway bind example using 0.0.0.0.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: package.json contains basic package metadata and no install hooks, dependency declarations, or automatic execution paths.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to answering Clawdbot documentation questions, running local helper scripts, fetching or linking docs, and citing source URLs; no instruction hijacking or unrelated behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, background worker, scheduled task installation, credential harvesting, or local auth/session-store access was found in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Clawdbot documentation navigation, search, fetching, version tracking, and reusable config snippets; the SKILL.md, package metadata, snippets, and scripts align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install as a documentation aid. Before copying its gateway example, consider changing the bind host to 127.0.0.1 for local-only use or ensure authentication, firewalling, and TLS/reverse-proxy controls are in place for remote access.
llm.findings: [T09] expected: The flagged 0.0.0.0 gateway host appears in a visible documentation config snippet, not in automatically executed code. It is purpose-aligned but should be treated carefully because copying it can expose the gateway on all network interfaces unless the deployment has proper access controls.
